name: Lisa Harper
bio: You rarely hear "hilarious storyteller" and "theological scholar" used to describe the same person. Lisa is both. Her teaching pairs careful, sound Bible exposition with stories that make a room laugh, and it keeps landing in one place: knowing about God pales next to actually knowing Jesus.

She has spent more than 30 years in church and parachurch ministry, including six years leading Focus on the Family's national women's ministry and a decade on the Women of Faith tour. She holds a Master of Theological Studies from Covenant Seminary and a doctorate from Houston Theological Seminary. She has written 17 books, including the bestselling devotional *Jesus*, and hosts the *Back Porch Theology* podcast.
Ask her about her greatest accomplishment and she won't name a book. She'll tell you about becoming Missy's mom. After several adoption losses, she brought her daughter home from Haiti in 2014.
quote: I'm so grateful for the opportunities God's given me but don't forget, He often uses donkeys and rocks!
